title: Slot-Grammar Script Engine
emptyText: Offer a seed idea below, set the fidelity, and forge.
description: Five-slot monologue forge with FIDELITY dial

tests.input: why the night sky is dark
tests.output:
Does the dark between the stars hold a hidden wall, or does it hold nothing at all?

Cosmologists of the closed model state, with full confidence, that an infinite sky would blaze in every direction, which is the olbers paradox of the old universe.

It follows, as an implication, that the darkness is a measure of time, not of emptiness, and the horizon of light resembles a mind that has not yet been reached.

A second witness, the observer, has realized that the sky is dark because the sight of every watcher is entirely bounded by the age of the thing it studies.

You are the horizon. Nothing else is dark.
